C-72.Name: Reconcile GRACE 4 current state after the 2.5.3 stabilization wave
C-72.Summary: Reconcile durable GRACE 4 current-state artifacts, file-local semantic projections, executable verification, active change lifecycles, and delivery bookkeeping with the observed repository state after the 2.5.3 stabilization wave. The reconciliation must preserve runtime behavior and historical evidence while making future semantic navigation and verification truthful again.

Goals.Goal: Classify every active change bundle as ongoing, completed, superseded, obsolete, or otherwise requiring an explicit evidence-backed disposition.
Correct routed graph module paths and lifecycle states where shipped source differs from durable current state, including M-045 and the flat Rust module paths.
Replace stale or non-executable verification entries with current commands, scenarios, markers, and assertion evidence, including a complete V-M-045 contract.
Replace legacy-only file-local LINKS projections with routed GRACE 4 graph and verification references without changing code behavior.
Correct the current 2.5.x delivery ledger to reflect observed implementation and verification evidence without inventing acceptance or release state.
Resolve main-worktree GRACE lint drift and document an intentional boundary for registered nested worktrees.

Constraints.Constraint: Preserve all GRACE 3 provenance under docs/*.xml and docs/migrations byte-for-byte.
Base lifecycle and delivery decisions only on repository evidence; do not reconstruct historical work as retroactive change bundles.
Keep archive paths and identifiers stable, and preserve existing evidence when moving an eligible bundle from active to archive.
Keep runtime and user-visible behavior unchanged.
Do not delete registered worktrees, branches, historical evidence, or archived change material.
Use current repository package-manager and test conventions rather than obsolete Yarn-era commands.
Follow the current release train protocol and keep implementation, verification, owner acceptance, queueing, and release states distinct.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Implement product features, bug fixes, runtime refactors, or UI changes.
Cut a release, bump a version, create or push a tag, publish artifacts, or edit GitHub release notes.
Claim owner acceptance, queueing, or release status that is not supported by the current delivery ledger.
Rewrite frozen GRACE 3 provenance or historical archived change records.
Remove nested worktrees or discard uncommitted work from any worktree.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: All active change bundles have an explicit evidence-backed disposition, and completed or superseded bundles approved for archival are moved with their evidence intact.
M-045 and other shipped modules covered by this change have truthful current paths and lifecycle states in the routed graph.

V-M-045 contains active commands, scenarios, markers, and assertion evidence, and the affected active command surfaces no longer use obsolete Yarn-era commands or deleted test paths; migrated LegacyBase evidence remains historical.
Governed source and test files in scope no longer rely exclusively on frozen GRACE 3 documents for file-local LINKS navigation.
The current 2.5.x release train records the observed table-footer implementation and verification state while preserving unaccepted and unreleased status unless separately evidenced.
Main-worktree current-state lint has no unresolved structural errors; any remaining warnings are intentional, explained, and bounded.
Current assertions, targeted IPC and Rust verification, and repository diff checks pass within declared budgets.

VerificationIntent.Intent: Run GRACE current-assertion lint and module-aware status after reconciliation.
Use focused IPC type and Vitest checks for updated renderer verification entries.
Use filtered Rust tests for M-045 extension hosting and M-022 path handling.
Assert that obsolete commands, stale module paths, and legacy-only file-local LINKS are absent from the reconciled scope.
Verify that frozen GRACE 3 provenance remains unchanged and that the final repository diff is structurally clean.

Approval.ApprovedBy: Owner, 2026-10-20: "OK" to the recommendation to create C-72 through grace-spec followed by grace-plan.
Approval.ApprovalScope: Create the approved C-72 specification and a reviewable draft plan for the bounded current-state reconciliation described here.
